name: glance
description: A status band above the prompt: project, model and effort, coloured context use, 5h and 7d plan limits with reset times.

ctxWarn.title: Context orange above (%)
ctxWarn.description: Context use above this percentage turns orange.

ctxCrit.title: Context red above (%)
ctxCrit.description: Context use above this percentage turns red.

folderIcon.title: Folder icon
folderIcon.description: Shown before the project folder; empty hides it.

modelIcon.title: Model icon
modelIcon.description: Shown before the model; empty hides it.

textColor.title: Text colour
textColor.description: Colour of the band's plain text, as a hex code (#8aa4c8) or a theme colour name.

showFiveHourReset.title: Show 5h reset countdown
showFiveHourReset.description: Show how long until the 5-hour window resets.

showWeeklyReset.title: Show weekly reset time
showWeeklyReset.description: Show the day and time the 7-day window resets.
